capabilities: Set a daily writing goal with a progress ring, calendar, and celebration
Track writing history with weekly, monthly, and yearly totals
Show per-note stats such as words, read time, syllables, sentences, and pages
Add word or character counts beside names in the file explorer
Run a writing session countdown timer
extras: Offers Ko-fi donations; lists planned features (goal targets, streaks, stats import, repeated-word analysis) in docs/feature-plans/; today's count tracks only genuinely new words, so deleting old text never lowers it; files or folders named with a leading "(SL)" are excluded from all counts.
problem: Obsidian's word-count status bar only shows counts for the current note, with no daily goals, writing history, or per-note statistics for a larger writing project.

relations.evidence: It comes from the Target column of the (SL) Visualization plugin's Outline file

summary: Writing-goal tracker that sets daily word or character goals and shows writing history, story stats, per-note counts, and a session timer for a story folder.
